title: Lyrics
emptyHint: Write or paste the lyrics, or attach an .lrc file.
notSynced: These lyrics aren't synced to the music.

sync.title: Sync lyrics
sync.hint: Press when the highlighted line starts. Space works too.

emptyState.notFoundHint: LRCLIB has nothing for this track.
